notes.title: True Colours New Trailer And Branding!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone!  Borealis here![/h1]

Today's announcement is very important to me; in the months since True Colours first released, I've had a variety of lovely feedback from players.  However, a theme has started to recur about the game's plot twist, and how it's been kept secret within the game's trailer and advertising.  I intentionally kept this plot twist under wraps so that it would be a big surprise when you play the game.  However, a few people have expressed shock in a negative way when they reached the big reveal, and after reading their comments, I can understand why.

True Colours has always been advertised as a romance/horror, but the context of the horror aspect was the secret that I left you to discover upon playing.  I can now see why, due to the somewhat extreme nature of the plot twist, this may not have been the best strategy.  Therefore, I've taken you all into consideration and created a brand new trailer and description for the game.  This way, you'll know what you're getting into ahead of time, and can make that decision for yourself whether to play or not.  I want you all to enjoy your gaming experience without any nasty shocks!  Unexpected plot elements, sure, but no actual upset!

So there you have it - if you're thinking of buying True Colours, please hop over to the store page and check out this new media, which will give you a much clearer snapshot of the game's content and themes.  If our crazy horror twist looks too much for you, then I understand, and am glad that you could make that judgement before buying.  On the other hand, if you're the kind of gamer that loves playing as a villain with a redemption arc, then come on in - this is the perfect game for you!

Cards on the table.  No more secrets.  You're welcome.

[h1]Big love to you all!

Borealis[/h1]

notes.title: Voice Acting Is Coming To True Colours!
notes.notes:
[b]Get your ears ready, gamers!  Borealis here with some BIG news![/b]

You read correctly - it's my absolute pleasure to announce that True Colours will officially feature voice acting!  This is something that Venus: Improbable Dream didn't have.  So many new features are coming to True Colours that I couldn't make happen before, and I'm so happy to be able to implement it all and share it with you!  Lemme fill you in on some sweet details about the voice acting:


[list]
[*] True Colours will be partially voice acted.  This means that instead of every single line being spoken as you read it, each character will have a set of words, short phrases and noises to reflect different emotions and responses, and one will play each time they speak.  This is a less time-consuming but still really effective way to help those characters to feel more real,  and for you to connect with them more deeply when you hear them speak!

[*] Six characters will be receiving voice actors.  Brianna, Malik, Ash, Sean, Lydia and the Boss will have their very own voices!

[*] The protagonist will not have voice acting.  I chose to leave them out for maximum self-insertability - I want you to be able to put yourself in their shoes as much as possible, and for this reason, I've already given them a gender neutral appearance.  To build on this, I believe leaving them voiceless will further enhance this transparency so that they can feel even more like 'you', without forcing you to have a specific voice.  The protagonist will have a couple of subtle noises assigned to them - breathing or gasping, for example - but no actual voice.
[/list]


So there you have it!  How's that for a sweet bonus feature?  Keep your eyes firmly on the official Borealis Games Twitter next week, because some voice acting teasers will be coming your way!

[b]See ya soon!
Borealis[/b]

notes.title: True Colours Free Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey gamers!  Musician and indie games developer Borealis here![/b]

I'm thrilled to introduce you all to my current game in development - True Colours!  It's a sweet dating sim style visual novel with a DARK horror twist!  Intrigued?  Keep reading!

To kickstart things with a bang, [b]I'm happy to present the True Colours demo, which has just released right here on Steam![/b]  It provides 30-45 minutes of gameplay depending on your reading speed, and helps to really set the scene for our story.
